_comment: The city each major airport serves: a curated dataset (CC BY 4.0, see datasets/LICENSE.md), so that a search for an airport code answers the city people mean (YYZ -> Toronto, not Mississauga, the town the airport sits in, which is what OurAirports' municipality gives). Covers every OurAirports large airport with an IATA code and the medium airports with scheduled service in India, the US and Canada. Fields: iata; airport (OurAirports' name, for reading); city, country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) and geonames (the GeoNames id of the city: a row of the world pack's cities layer); basis (curated: checked by hand; geonames: GeoNames lists the code among the city's names; nearby: of the cities of the airport's country within 60 km, the one with the highest population / (km + 10)^2, the rule the build applies to airports this file doesn't list); notes (required when the city is in another country than the airport, and wherever the choice needs a word). packbuild.served checks every entry (the id is a city of that name and country, within 100 km of the airport) and writes the world pack's airports.served_city. Remote airports with no city of 1,000 people within 60 km are left out. Corrections: change basis to curated.
